gui.app.title: TMAegis
gui.auth.required: Access denied. Open the address printed by the tmaegis gui command in your terminal; it contains this session's access token.
gui.nav.label: Main navigation
gui.lang.label: Language
gui.quit.title: Quit TMAegis?
gui.quit.body: This stops the local server. A change that is still waiting for confirmation will be rolled back first.
gui.quit.stopped_body: The local server is no longer running. You can close this tab.
gui.copy.failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
gui.admin.ok: This session has administrator or root privileges, so changes can be applied.
gui.admin.missing_title: Not running as administrator or root
gui.admin.missing_body: Scanning works, but some checks may be incomplete and applying or restoring changes is disabled. Restart TMAegis with elevated privileges to enable it.
gui.admin.how.linux: Close this window, then start the GUI again from a terminal with sudo:

gui.dashboard.title: Dashboard
gui.dashboard.lede: Check this machine against the CIS Benchmarks, review the findings and fix them with a safety snapshot.
gui.dashboard.scan_hint: A scan only reads settings. It never changes your system.
gui.dashboard.no_scan: No scan yet. Run your first scan to see a compliance score.
gui.dashboard.quick_picks_hint: Start a scan limited to one target detected on this machine.
gui.score.label: score
gui.scan.title: Scan
gui.scan.lede: Choose what to audit. The scan runs in the background and you can cancel it at any time.
gui.scan.scope_auto_desc: Audit the operating system and the software found on this machine.
gui.scan.scope_target_desc: Audit a single platform or product, for example nginx or postgres.
gui.scan.scope_dir_desc: Audit every rule in the chosen directory that applies to this operating system.
gui.scan.target_hint: Type a target name or pick one from the list.
gui.scan.rules_dir_hint: Pick the main rules or the staging rules that are still being reviewed.
gui.scan.level1_desc: Practical baseline with little risk of disruption.
gui.scan.level2_desc: Stricter controls for high-security environments. Includes Level 1.
gui.scan.manual_desc: List recommendations that need a human decision. They are reported as skipped.
gui.scan.os_family_hint: Replace the detected OS family, for example windows-11. Use * to include every family.
gui.scan.safe_body: Scanning runs the audit commands of the rules but never applies any change. Fixing is a separate step with a preview.
gui.scan.cancelled: The scan was cancelled. No results were saved.
gui.scan.failed: The scan could not be completed. {error}
gui.results.title: Results
gui.results.subtitle: Host {host}, scanned {date} ({os}).
gui.results.empty_body: Run a scan and its results will appear here.
gui.results.download: Download the report in another format
gui.table.search: Search by ID, title or target
gui.table.caption: Audit results
gui.fix.title: Fix
gui.fix.lede: Select failing controls, preview exactly what would change, then apply with a safety snapshot and a confirmation timer.
gui.fix.source: Based on the scan from {date} on {host}.
gui.fix.not_elevated_title: Applying changes needs administrator or root privileges
gui.fix.not_elevated_body: You can still select controls and preview them. Applying is disabled until TMAegis is restarted with elevated privileges.
gui.fix.none_body: None of the failing controls in this scan has an automated remediation.
gui.fix.no_auto.one: {count} failing control has no automated remediation and is not listed.
gui.fix.no_auto.other: {count} failing controls have no automated remediation and are not listed.
gui.fix.caption: Failing controls that can be remediated
gui.fix.quick_hint: Quick wins change a single configuration line or run a command that verifies itself.
gui.fix.dry_running: Running a dry run. Nothing is being changed.
gui.fix.dry_note: This is a dry run. Nothing has been changed yet.
gui.fix.apply_blocked: Applying is disabled because TMAegis is not running with elevated privileges. You can still review the changes.
gui.fix.suggest_note: Suggestion only. This control is not changed directly.
gui.fix.unsupported.one: {count} selected control has no automated remediation and is skipped.
gui.fix.unsupported.other: {count} selected controls have no automated remediation and are skipped.
gui.fix.dry_failures.one: {count} control reported a problem during the dry run. Review the output above before applying.
gui.fix.dry_failures.other: {count} controls reported a problem during the dry run. Review the output above before applying.
gui.fix.snapshot_body.one: {count} file will be backed up to {dir} before anything is changed.
gui.fix.snapshot_body.other: {count} files will be backed up to {dir} before anything is changed.
gui.fix.snapshot_taken: Snapshot {id} was taken before the changes.
gui.fix.deadman_body: After the changes are applied you must confirm that the system still works. If you do not confirm in time, everything is rolled back automatically.
gui.fix.code_hint: The code is shown only in this window and protects against accidental clicks.
gui.fix.ack: I understand that this changes system settings.
gui.fix.await_title: Changes applied. Confirm to keep them.
gui.fix.await_body: Check that the system still works, for example that you can still sign in. If the timer ends, all changes are rolled back.
gui.fix.result_done: The changes were confirmed and are kept.
gui.fix.result_rolled_back: The changes were rolled back and the previous state was restored.
gui.fix.result_failed_rolled: Applying failed and the previous state was restored. {error}
gui.history.title: History
gui.history.lede: Past scans, safety snapshots and everything this interface has done.
gui.history.trend_aria: Score trend from {first} percent to {last} percent
gui.history.trend_empty: Run at least two scans to see a trend.
gui.history.no_scans: No scans have been saved yet.
gui.history.no_snapshots: No snapshots yet. One is taken automatically before changes are applied.
gui.history.restore_blocked: Restoring needs administrator or root privileges.
gui.restore.title: Restore snapshot
gui.restore.warning: This puts the files saved in snapshot {id} ({date}) back in place and overwrites their current content.
gui.settings.title: Settings
gui.settings.lede: Preferences are stored only on this computer.
gui.settings.rules_hint: Leave empty to use the default directory: {dir}
gui.settings.ai_note: These values come from the configuration file and the command line. This interface never stores API keys.
gui.settings.privacy: Everything stays on this computer. The interface makes no requests to the internet.

gui.beta.label: Beta

gui.err.bad_content_type: The request has an unsupported content type.

gui.err.not_elevated: Administrator or root privileges are required for this action.
gui.err.bad_confirm: The confirmation code does not match.
gui.err.preview_required: Preview these changes first, then apply them.
gui.err.no_rules: No rules match this scope and level.
gui.err.snapshot_failed: The safety snapshot could not be created, so nothing was changed.
gui.err.invalid_dir: The rules directory was not found.
gui.err.rules_load_failed: The rules could not be loaded.
gui.err.unsupported_format: This report format is not supported.
gui.err.render_failed: The report could not be created.
gui.err.restore_failed: The snapshot could not be restored.
gui.err.no_remediation: None of the selected controls can be fixed automatically.
gui.shell.offline_banner: Lost the connection to the local TMAegis server. Retrying automatically.
gui.shell.reconnected: Connection to the local server restored.
gui.admin.how_title: How to restart with elevated privileges
gui.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
gui.keys.intro: Shortcuts work everywhere except while you type in a field. Press G, then a letter, to jump to a page.
gui.dash.delta_same: No change since the previous scan
gui.dash.bench_none: No rules in the current rules directory
gui.dash.catalog: The rules directory covers {rules} rules for {targets} platforms.
gui.dash.donut_aria: Failing controls by severity, {n} in total. The legend lists each severity.
gui.wiz.title: New scan
gui.wiz.lede: Choose what to audit, set the options, then review what will run before you start. Scanning never changes your system.
gui.wiz.what: What do you want to scan?
gui.wiz.mode_pick_desc: Pick one or more benchmarks from the catalog, for example a database or a network device.
gui.wiz.search: Search platforms by name or ID
gui.wiz.device_available.one: {count} more device rule runs if you add an exported device configuration in the options.
gui.wiz.device_available.other: {count} more device rules run if you add an exported device configuration in the options.
gui.dev.title: Device configuration
gui.dev.body.one: {names} is audited from an exported configuration, for example the output of show running-config.
gui.dev.body.other: These platforms are audited from an exported configuration, for example the output of show running-config: {names}.
gui.dev.drop: Drop the exported configuration file here
gui.dev.drop_hint: Plain text, up to 8 MB. The file is read on this computer only.
gui.dev.only_device: With a device configuration, only the device rules of the selected platforms run, like --device-config on the command line.
gui.dev.sample_hint: No device at hand? The repository ships synthetic sample configurations under samples/network/ that you can try.
gui.dev.sample_found: Synthetic sample configurations are available for a test run. They are not secure templates.
gui.prog.title: Audit in progress
gui.prog.stream_empty: Results appear here as each rule finishes.
gui.res.select_all_fixable: Select every fixable failing rule shown
gui.drawer.no_remediation: This control has no automated remediation. Follow the reference to fix it manually.
gui.explain.title: Why is this a manual check?
gui.explain.why: The benchmark asks for a human decision here: the right setting depends on your organization, or it cannot be read reliably by a script. It is reported as skipped and does not change the score.
gui.explain.step2: Check the setting on the system and compare it with your policy.
gui.explain.step3: Record the decision in your change or risk register, then follow the reference if a change is needed.
gui.fx.risk_note: Risk is an estimate from the kind of change, for example restarting a service or changing access. Review every change; the snapshot and the confirmation timer protect you either way.
gui.fx.reason.service_or_access: Can restart services or change access
gui.fx.ack_detail.one: {count} change will be applied after a snapshot is taken.
gui.fx.ack_detail.other: {count} changes will be applied after a snapshot is taken.
gui.fx.not_ready: Type the code and tick the box to enable Apply.
gui.fx.countdown_announce: {n} seconds left to confirm the changes.
gui.diff.truncated: The diff is shortened. The full change is in the dry-run output.
gui.diff.unchanged: {file} already contains the expected line. Nothing would change.
gui.diff.err_unreadable: The current file could not be read, so only the new line is shown.
gui.diff.err_bad_regex: The rule's match expression is invalid.
gui.hist.compare_hint: Select two scans to compare them.
gui.hist.pick: Select the scan from {date} for comparison
gui.hist.restore_intro: A snapshot of every affected file is taken before changes are applied. Restoring puts those files back.
gui.cmp.title: Compare scans
gui.cmp.lede: What changed between two scans. The older scan is always shown first.
gui.cmp.unchanged.one: {count} rule has the same result in both scans.
gui.cmp.unchanged.other: {count} rules have the same result in both scans.
gui.plat.lede: {rules} rules for {targets} platforms in {categories} categories. Pick one to start a scan limited to it.
gui.group.mainframe: Mainframe: IBM i and IBM Z
gui.set.beta_note: Languages marked Beta are machine-translated and awaiting review by a native speaker.
gui.set.beta_current: You are using a Beta translation. Some wording may be inaccurate; English is the reference.
gui.set.theme_dark: Deep navy with cyan and emerald accents.
gui.about.tagline: Open-source CIS Benchmark auditing and safe, reversible hardening for operating systems, servers, databases, cloud and network devices.
gui.about.license_note: You may use, change and share TMAegis. Changes to its source files must stay under the same license.
gui.about.copyright: Copyright 2026 Tommy Huynh and Misha Milanovic.
gui.about.security: This interface listens on 127.0.0.1 only, needs the per-run access token printed in the terminal, and asks for a confirmation code before it changes anything.
gui.err.too_large: The file is too large. The limit is 8 MB.
gui.err.no_device_config: The device configuration was not found. Add the file again.
gui.about.brands: Product names, logos and brands are property of their respective owners and are used only to identify supported platforms.
